  1. Requirements definition
  2. Powertrain, Range & Charging

Easy and reliable public charging, including the Supercharger network

Proposal
1, implement. Public charging (33 rows) and charging the battery (20 rows) complaints describe broken stations, queues, failed registration for the free charging offer and no NACS adapter.
Horizon
H1. Adapter, partner network and app.
Domain
Powertrain, Range & Charging
Markets
US
Evidence level
B (the best level of the primary and supporting findings)
Status
proposed, version 1
Reference
REQ-G70-US-PR-03 (the key of the decisions, the audit trail and the exports)

Statement

i7 owners shall be able to charge at Tesla Superchargers, register the included charging offer without help, and plan trips around stations that are reported working.

Acceptance criteria

One row per market where expectations differ. Basis: evidence is a measured study value or a count; assumption is the agent's proposal for the product manager to set.

MarketMetricTargetHow measuredBasis
USNACS accessAdapter supplied at deliveryOffer checkevidence
USCharging offer activation without dealer help>= 95 % of ownersApp analyticsassumption

    Customers of the BMW 7 Series (US) raise 33 complaint rows about 'Public charging / external providers' (5 defects, 21 usability problems, 7 wishes) from 3 source type(s); that is 1.3% of all complaint rows in this market and 87% of what customers say about this theme.

    Figures. 38 rows: 5 likes, 33 complaints (5 defects, 21 difficult to use, 7 wants). 1.3 % of the market's 2,498 complaint rows; 87% of the theme's rows are complaints. by powertrain: BEV 38. by source: Source B 21, Source A 15, Source C 2. by country: US 38.

    • Customer noted that roughly half the chargers at the FastCharge Network stations never seem to work, which was part of his hesitaton about going electric.

      G70-2228 · Source B · US · BEV · Defect, Public charging / external providers, Malfunction · G70_feedback_hackathon.xlsx, row 2,613

    • awesome car, we mainly use it for going out in the evenings, not as a work vehicle. i do wish a charge gave more miles. the 3 year free charging isn't working, we had issues registering and finding the right spot, lots of frustration until the sales manager at the dealer helped.

      G70-1215 · Source A · US · BEV · Defect, Public charging / external providers, Installation and set-up: difficult · G70_feedback_hackathon.xlsx, row 1,437

    • Customer stated that a lot of the Electrify America chargers are not working. Customer stated that on one occasion the charger plug got stuck and would not disconnect from the car. Customer stated Electrify America had to send a technician to take the handle apart to get it loose from the vehicle. Customer stated the car itself was fine. Customer stated he ended up stuck at that charger for around 2 hours.

      G70-1181 · Source B · US · BEV · Defect, Public charging / external providers, Malfunction · G70_feedback_hackathon.xlsx, row 1,388

    • Customer reported that plug and charge is not functioning, stating it seemed like there was no connection from the vehicle. Customer explained they tried to start the session through the app, which appeared to confuse everything, immediately ended the session, and left them unable to charge. Customer ultimately paid for charging instead. Writer confirmed plug and charge is enabled in iDrive and suggested reaching out to EA if the problem persists.

      G70-1891 · Source B · US · BEV · Defect, Public charging / external providers, Malfunction · G70_feedback_hackathon.xlsx, row 2,193

    • right now there is basically no charging network in places that feel safe. the car itself was pretty loud and it came across like the build quality was worse than the m8 we owned before, with a lot of road noise, mainly on the driver side. the vehicle is gorgeous and rides nicely, but i really think bmw should include adapters so you can charge at brighter, well lit stations. most of the chargers we found were out in the middle of nowhere, and many of them were not on charge america, so the 30 minutes of free charging perk almost never got used. i really liked the exterior styling and the interior design. i ended up giving it a rating of 3 because it seems fine for driving around town, but feels unsafe for long trips. my wife was nearly stuck in the middle of oklahoma because the charging station was closed and located inside a dealership. she had to sit charging for hours in a rough part of town, in an area with bad lighting. on top of all that, the safety system in the car and the steering assist stopped working early in the journey. overall, i honestly would not suggest buying an electric car right now, at least until bmw sorts out being able to charge safely while traveling.

      G70-2474 · Source A · US · BEV · Defect, Public charging / external providers, Malfunction · G70_feedback_hackathon.xlsx, row 2,904

    • Customer mentioned they feel nervous about going on a long trip and about charging the vehicle, and said that is mostly a personal issue rather than anything else.
